title.narrative: Government leadership in nutrition sector coordination has advanced significantly, supported by strengthened systems for large-scale delivery of high-impact interventions. Somalia has expanded digital platforms for nutrition data and supply chain monitoring nationwide, integrating real-time dashboards and linking them to health facilities for improved accountability and decision-making.
